description_en: Queries network connectivity in the current tenant by name and returns the connection status, associated VPC, and network configurations of the corresponding type
description_zh: 按名称查询当前租户中的网络连接，返回连接状态、关联 VPC 和对应类型的网络配置
name: GetNetworkLink

parameters.help_en: The name of the network connectivity in the tenant
parameters.help_zh: 租户中的网络连接名称
parameters.name: network_link_name

data.description_en: The business data of the network connectivity
data.description_zh: 获取网络连接的业务数据

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the network connectivity. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
createTime.description_zh: 网络连接的创建时间，使用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

name.description_en: The name of the network connectivity

passthroughProperties.description_en: The network configurations of the passthrough network connectivity, including the vSwitch and security group
passthroughProperties.description_zh: 透传型网络连接的网络配置，包括交换机和安全组

securityGroup.description_en: The ID of the security group used by the passthrough connection
securityGroup.description_zh: 透传型连接使用的安全组 ID

vSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch used by the passthrough connection
vSwitchId.description_zh: 透传型连接使用的交换机 ID

region.description_en: The region ID of the network connectivity
region.description_zh: 网络连接所属的地域 ID

reverseaccessProperties.description_en: The configurations of the reverse access network connectivity, including the destination address and active zone
reverseaccessProperties.description_zh: 反向访问型网络连接的配置，包括目标地址和可用区

target.description_en: The destination IP address or domain name and port for reverse access. Multiple destinations are separated by semicolons
target.description_zh: 反向访问的目标 IP 或域名及端口，多个目标以分号分隔

zoneId.description_en: The active zone ID of the reverse access network connectivity
zoneId.description_zh: 反向访问型网络连接的可用区 ID

status.description_en: The current status of the network connectivity

type.description_en: The type of the network connectivity, such as PASSTHROUGH or reverse access (REVERSEACCESS)
type.description_zh: 网络连接类型，例如透传型 PASSTHROUGH 或反向访问型 REVERSEACCESS

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC associated with the network connectivity
vpcId.description_zh: 网络连接关联的专有网络 ID

errorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
errorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

errorMsg.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
errorMsg.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

httpCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request
httpCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the API request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次 API 请求的唯一标识，可用于排查调用问题

v1_parameters.help_en: The name of the network connectivity in the tenant
v1_parameters.help_zh: 租户中的网络连接名称
v1_parameters.name: networkLinkName
